subject.title: fix(fal): apply request policy to media generation requests

question: Is the controlled FAL-compatible provider-path transcript sufficient for this security-boundary change, or must the contributor provide redacted real FAL or representative proxy/private-network proof?
rationale: The patch follows the established explicit opt-in contract and has no remaining correctness finding, but repository policy requires live testing for external API work and the evidence does not exercise the real external transport path.

options.title: Require representative network proof
options.body: Keep merge blocked until redacted evidence exercises real FAL or a representative proxy/private-network route, including the intended cross-media URL scope.

options.title: Accept controlled provider proof
options.body: Explicitly override the live-proof requirement because the transcript exercises the normal provider path and the patch only connects the canonical sanitized resolver.

recommendation.title: Require representative network proof
recommendation.body: Keep merge blocked until redacted evidence exercises real FAL or a representative proxy/private-network route, including the intended cross-media URL scope.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the shared request transport contract whose intended security scope controls this proof decision.
